name: message-reader
title: Message Reader
description: A message to read on its own, over the conversation: its title and what it is, a search of its text alone (Ctrl or Cmd F, Enter and Shift+Enter through the matches, drawn as CSS highlights), the app's actions and ⋯ menu, its outline beside it where the dialog (not the window) is wide enough and how far the reader is along the top, its text at a reading size. On a phone it is the whole screen, with back, the title, the menu, and a bar of the outline, search, how far and the actions. It opens as DialogContent's size="full".
